title: Runtime capability record 1
description: What one runtime, at one version, on one platform, was measured to be able to prove. Adapter-owned and separate from the agent-work contract: roles state what they require, records state what a runtime can prove, and the renderer matches the two.

record_version.description: Schema version of this record format. Exact match; a reader does not reinterpret another version.

status.description: `measured` records are evidence. `example` records are fixtures and must never satisfy a capability requirement, whatever they claim.

family.description: Runtime family. A record proves nothing about another family.

version.description: Exact runtime version as the runtime itself reports it. No ranges: no evidence exists for what a range would claim.

os.description: Measurement platform. Evidence from one OS never certifies another.

detail.description: Free text for a human reader, e.g. a uname string. Must not carry a user name, home directory or host name.

measured_at.description: Date of the measurement run. Provenance only: staleness is decided by version, platform and probe digest, never by age.

adapter_revision.description: Distribution revision the probes were run from.

capabilities.description: Keyed by the capability names the agent-work contract defines. A capability absent from this object is unknown, and unknown fails closed.

evidence_requirements.description: The evidence level each capability demands before a role requiring it may render. Read by the validator and the renderer so there is one definition, not two. `enforced` satisfies both levels; `observed` satisfies only `observation`.

state.description: enforced: the runtime demonstrably prevents the violation. observed: behaviour seen, prevention untested. unavailable: exercised and absent. unmeasured: no probe run. documented: vendor documentation only.

reason.description: Why a capability is unmeasured. Required for that state, so unknown never collapses into a bare false.

source.description: Where a documented-only claim comes from. Required for `documented`.

probe.description: Repository-relative path to the probe that produced this observation.

probe_sha256.description: Digest of the probe at measurement time. A probe that has since changed invalidates this evidence.

kind.description: `enforcement` means the runtime was seen refusing the violation, not merely the agent complying.

observation.description: What was actually seen, in terms that can be checked against the probe's output.
